notes: Intransitive verb (never takes ने). When compounded with जाना (सो जाना), it specifically means 'to fall asleep'.
Do not confuse with the homonym सोना ('gold', masculine noun) or with लेटना ('to lie down').

draftBefore.emotion: peaceful and quiet, like drifting off after a long day
notes: While सोना (sona) also means 'gold' (a noun), as a verb it always refers to sleeping. Make sure not to confuse it with 'to lie down' (लेटना, letna).
In Hindi, you often use the verb with the postposition 'में' (in) when talking about falling asleep, though the verb on its own is the standard way to express the action of sleeping.

senses.definition: To rest with your eyes closed and your body inactive, usually at night.

examples.emotion: gentle and careful, speaking softly to avoid waking someone up

senses.definition: To fall into a state of unconsciousness, typically for rest.

examples.emotion: tired and wanting to end the day, seeking comfort
